items.question: What painting was stolen from The Louvre exactly 56 years before the birth of activist and songwriter Serj Tankian?
corpus: The Mona Lisa is a half-length portrait painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci. It was stolen from the Louvre in 1911 and recovered in 1913.
Serj Tankian is an Armenian-American musician, singer, and songwriter born on August 21, 1967. He is best known as the lead vocalist of System of a Down.

items.question: What was the age difference between Mike Tyson and Tyson Fury on the respective days on which they lost their first ever fights? Represent the figure in years only.
corpus: Mike Tyson is an American former professional boxer. He lost his first professional fight as a teenager in the amateur era context; his first pro loss came later in his career.
Tyson Fury is a British professional boxer born on August 12, 1988. He suffered his first defeat in a professional bout in 2024.

items.question: What is the capital of France?
corpus: Paris is the capital and largest city of France. It is situated on the River Seine in northern France.
